name: render-check-package-order
title: Make the settings render drift check insensitive to package order
description: doctor.sh fails on a semantically identical settings.json when a live `pi install` appends an always-on package after an enabled optional bundle's package, because render-settings.mjs --check compares the packages array order-sensitively while render emits core-then-optionals and live keeps install order.
creator: yuanhai.tan
